_source: Written by `bun run explain:probe:import-dry-run 7.24.5` (scripts/probes/explain-import-dry-run.ts) on stock CHR 7.24.5 x86, 2026-11-01, and copied here unedited. One disposable quickchr CHR per import run, destroyed after; uploads were verbatim bytes. No router is needed to read this file.

files.name: good.rsc
files.intent: two valid adds; plain/verbose must apply both, dry-run must apply neither
files.input:
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.1/32 comment=probe-520-a
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=198.51.100.7/32 comment=probe-520-b

files.name: mixed.rsc
files.intent: valid, bad command, valid; fail-fast shape, error multiplicity and coordinates
files.input:
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.9/32 comment=probe-520-c
this is not a command
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=203.0.113.4/32 comment=probe-520-d

files.name: side-fx.rsc
files.intent: harmless observable controls for what dry-run executes vs skips: identity rename plus one add
files.input:
/system identity set name=probe-520-side-fx
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.99/32 comment=probe-520-e

files.name: duplicate.rsc
files.intent: line 2 repeats line 1: a duplicate only exists once line 1 has applied (#203 blocker 1 class)
files.input:
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.20/32 comment=probe-520-f
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.20/32 comment=probe-520-f
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.21/32 comment=probe-520-g

files.name: builtin.rsc
files.intent: line 2 is #203 blocker 2 verbatim: set on the builtin `all` list
files.input:
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.30/32 comment=probe-520-h
/interface list set [ find name=all ] comment="contains all interfaces" exclude="" include="" name=all
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.31/32 comment=probe-520-i

files.name: missing-value.rsc
files.intent: line 2 is #203 blocker 3 verbatim: security=private without its passwords
files.input:
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.40/32 comment=probe-520-j
/snmp community add addresses=0.0.0.0/0 name=canary-snmp-priv security=private
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.41/32 comment=probe-520-k

files.name: missing-object.rsc
files.intent: line 2 names an interface that does not exist on the device
files.input:
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.50/32 comment=probe-520-l
/interface ethernet set ether99 comment=probe-520
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.51/32 comment=probe-520-m

files.intent: line 2 gives an enum property a value outside its enum
